scenes.label: Meet Tara
scenes.title: Thirty bakers want the job!
scenes.caption: Meet Tara. Every Saturday she helps at Aunt Meena's bakery, piping icing onto cupcakes. The bakery is so busy that Aunt Meena needs a new baker's helper. Thirty people have applied! To save time, she tries a new computer tool that picks a shortlist for her.
scenes.dialogue: Thirty bakers want to join us!

scenes.label: The shortlist
scenes.title: The best baker was left out.
scenes.caption: The tool picks three people, all from Hilltop School. Tara spots something odd. Priya isn't on the list! Priya won the Cyberpur cake contest and has baked for three years. The tool marked her: not a good match. How could the best baker be left out?
scenes.dialogue: Priya's the best baker in Cyberpur!

scenes.label: Old records
scenes.title: What did the tool learn from?
scenes.caption: Tara and Aunt Meena look at what the tool learned from: ten years of old hiring records. Nearly everyone hired came from Hilltop School, because the old manager only put job posters there. So the tool learned that Hilltop means a good baker. People call this garbage in, garbage out.
scenes.dialogue: So it copied an old, unfair habit?

scenes.label: Clean the data
scenes.title: Which column isn't about baking?
scenes.caption: Your turn. The training data has five columns. Remove the one that has nothing to do with baking, then rerun the shortlist. Careful: removing a real skill, like years of baking or the tasting score, would make the tool worse, not fairer.
scenes.dialogue: Which column isn't about baking at all?

scenes.label: Fair tools
scenes.title: The tool helps. People decide.
scenes.caption: Now Priya is on the shortlist! When a tool learns from past choices, it can copy past unfairness too. This is called bias. So check that every input is about the job, test the tool with many kinds of people, and let a person make the final choice.

scenes.label: A happier ending
scenes.title: Welcome to the team, Priya!
scenes.caption: Priya comes for a trial day and bakes a mango cake that makes everyone smile. Aunt Meena hires her! Tara has learned that a tool trained on unfair data gives unfair answers, so people must check it. Your turn: help Tara check who really has the right skills!
